page.overview:
Who is Eldamir?

was an ancient elven Archmage of the Librarium Incantatum and one of the seven of the Septarion, the council of Avalir during the Age of Arcanum. As an NPC, is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Eldamir was an ancient elf, bowed with age. When Patia met with him on the Eve of The Replenishment, he was wearing a shimmering golden cloak with small glimmering crystals of golden light that shimmered in geometric shapes, turned into motes, and floated away. His eyes were soft and smiling and he leaned on a wooden staff that he had wielded for centuries.

Eldamir was distinguished by his talkativeness, off-target verbosity, and nostalgia, often retelling stories of his past and losing himself in memories. In truth, he did not care about the lives of others and was willing to let an untold number of civilians die as long as the Septarions were protected, himself included.

Eldamir sat on the council since the beginning of Avalir with his exceptional knowledge of the arcane, overshadowing most wizards of the city.
